description: This is a Flutter widget implementing a secure lock screen for PIN setup and unlocking functionality. It manages PIN creation, confirmation, verification, biometric authentication fallback, and state transitions to navigate to the home screen upon success.

classes.name: LockScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages the PIN setup and unlocking flow with biometric fallback, including UI components and state handling.

classes.name: _LockScreenState
classes.description: State class for LockScreen, managing internal UI state, user inputs, and interactions with LockService.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes the lock screen by fetching configuration status from LockService and sets loading state accordingly.

methods.name: _onPinChanged
methods.description: Updates internal PIN input state upon user editing the TextField.

methods.name: _handleSetupSubmit
methods.description: Handles the PIN creation process, including confirmation, validation, and saving via LockService, then navigates to home.

methods.name: _handleUnlockSubmit
methods.description: Verifies entered PIN against stored PIN, manages retry attempts, and navigates upon success.

methods.name: _tryBiometric
methods.description: Attempts biometric authentication with LockService and navigates if successful.

methods.name: _toggleBiometric
methods.description: Enables or disables biometric preference in LockService, optionally performs an immediate biometric attempt.

methods.name: _navigateHome
methods.description: Performs navigation to the home route, clearing previous navigation stack.
